queries: OpenAI Anthropic API price increase customers Cursor Replit cost 2025 2026

sources_considered.why: Primary account of a downstream pricing change and its stated explanation.
Dated provider pricing disclosure, but it does not establish cost coverage.
A current price list cannot by itself establish a historical cost-covering repricing event.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'Why did we change the plan?'

receipt.public_excerpt: New models can spend more tokens per request

evidence_items.explanation: Cursor describes changing its customer plan as request costs became more variable. Higher token consumption does not demonstrate that OpenAI or Anthropic raised prices to cover their full costs.

evidence_items.locator: Opening section, paragraph announcing API availability

receipt.public_excerpt: Pricing is now $5/$25 per million tokens

evidence_items.explanation: This establishes an actual advertised model price. It supplies no provider cost calculation and therefore cannot establish the conditional forecast's antecedent.

unresolved_gaps: No verified repricing episode establishes that the provider began charging enough to cover the relevant costs.
No matched customer records establish the complete causal chain from such repricing to multiplied expenditure and business failure or feature cuts.
The forecast leaves the affected customer population and observation window unspecified.
